title: Entre vous filles (Clemens)
desc: Jacobus Clemens non Papa, Entre vous filles, before 1550. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0049); edited by Franz Körndle, Jonathan Stroh, Vincent Besson, Kévin Roger, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
